otherTracksConsidered.why: 5 Jul 2026 solo day from Lake Constance: the report says it followed the ridge traverse from The Pyramid (route 1), not the northwest buttress.

season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep kept. The only logged ascent was 9 Aug 2021 (Sean's Route, with Sean himself). WebSearch found no independent page for the route name.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 2021 ascent clearly describes this route (3 pitches in a crack system to a cave beneath a roof) but packet has no GPS track.
Ridge traverse from The Pyramid, different line.

facts.text: In August, after a few warm weeks, the snowfield and small glacier at the top of the cirque gave intense, constant rockfall on the way down; cross it early.
Ice axe and crampons for the small glacier at the top of the cirque (August)

Base camp at the big boulders just south of Home Creek; go up the scree to the obvious ramp, follow it around the right side of the prominent dihedral to a steep class 3/4 gully, and rope up at the base of the crack system.
Look for natural pockets in the rock along the first pitches; they make belay spots out of the fall line of loose rock.

season.evidence: Stored late June-July kept. WebSearch: considerable snow on the upper Constance massif into June; July-September most favourable weather. Only in-season logged ascents (5 Jul 2026, 9 Aug 2021) took other lines.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Report says the author skipped the easier gully route 2 and kept to the ridge (route 1) after a ridge traverse from The Pyramid, so the line is not the South Gully / East Ridge route; track begins at Lake Constance area, 7 km from our washout pin.

notes: Sean's Route/Second Wind is described by its own text as a variation finish on the Northwest Buttress; both rows share the face and pins and may overlap. No pins proposed.
